description: This file defines a class 'UploadedFile' that implements the 'UploadedFileInterface' to handle uploaded files in a PSR-7 compliant HTTP server environment. It manages file upload errors, moving uploaded files safely, and provides access to uploaded file's metadata and content streams.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Represents a file uploaded via an HTTP request, providing methods for accessing its data, moving it to a desired location, and retrieving upload error info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile instance with stream or filename, size, error status, and optional client filename/media type.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream representing the uploaded file's body.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a new location, handling different SAPI environments.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes, or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the upload error code as defined by PHP.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename provided by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type provided by the client.
